div.head: I Cn 6
div.ab: And we wyllað, þæt ælces hades menn georne gebugan ælc to þam rihte þe him to gebyrige.
And we wyllað, þæt ælces hades menn georne gebugan, ælc to þam rihte þe him to gebyrige.
And witena gerædnes is, þæt hi willað, þæt ælces hades men georne gebugan, ælc to ðam rihte þe him to gebyrige.
Et uolumus, ut quicumque sunt in ordine clericatus constituti, puris mentibus inclinentur singulariter ad eam rectitudinem quę ipsis pertinet.
And we wyllað þæt ælces hades menn georne gebugan ælc to þam rihte þe him to gebyrige.
And we wyllað þæt ælces hades menn georne gebugan, ælc to þam rihte þe him to gebyrige.
And we desire that men of every estate readily submit to the duty which befits them.
And we desire that those of every rank shall faithfully submit to the duty most appropriate for them.
Und wir (der Witan Verordnung ist, dass sie D) wünschen, dass die Menschen jedes Standes, jeder der Rechtspflicht, die ihm gebührt, sich willig unterwerfen,
And we will (it is the ordinance of the witan that they will, D) that people of every order eagerly submit, each to the duty that belongs to him,
